reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_name, p.launch_date, c.parent_category
FROM products p
JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
WHERE p.launch_date BETWEEN DATE '2022-01-01' AND DATE '2022-12-31'
alternatives: SELECT p.product_name, p.launch_date, c.parent_category FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE p.launch_date >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND p.launch_date < DATE '2023-01-01'
SELECT p.product_name, p.launch_date, c.parent_category FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM p.launch_date) = 2022

other_way.sql: SELECT p.product_name, p.launch_date, c.parent_category FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM p.launch_date) = 2022
other_way.tradeoff: EXTRACT of the year reads simply, but a plain date range shows both ends of the period at a glance.
